# Xe Cố Đô Xanh

> Xe Cố Đô Xanh provides electric motorbike and e-bike rentals in Ninh Binh, Vietnam, with delivery to guest accommodation and local attractions.

## Main pages

- [Homepage - Vietnamese](https://xecodoxanh.com/): Rental overview, vehicle options, prices, delivery, and local destinations.
- [Homepage - English](https://xecodoxanh.com/index-en.html): English-language rental information.
- [Booking](https://xecodoxanh.com/booking): Choose a vehicle and submit a rental request.
- [Pricing](https://xecodoxanh.com/pricing): Rental prices and included equipment.
- [Travel guides](https://xecodoxanh.com/news): Ninh Binh itineraries and electric motorbike rental advice.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://xecodoxanh.com/faq): Answers about rental requirements and service.
- [Contact](https://xecodoxanh.com/contact): Contact and business information.
